title: Melania Trump Launches 2027 Presidential Superintelligence Challenge for K 12 Schools
summary:
A new federal competition is inviting students and teachers across the country to develop next generation technical innovation. First Lady Melania Trump has introduced the 2027 Presidential Superintelligence Challenge, a contest open to K 12 students and educators that allows participating schools to earn the First Lady Seal of SI Readiness to certify their preparation for the super intelligence era.

The competition is a rebranding of a previous student artificial intelligence contest. The change in terminology aligns with a Sept. 29 executive order by President Trump, which directs all government agencies to use the term "super intelligence" rather than "artificial intelligence" in all public statements, agency materials, and official government documents.
